notice.directive: Seek emergency department assessment now. Do not wait for a message reply; call 911 if you cannot travel safely.

event.text: Please go to an emergency department now for assessment today. If your breathing worsens at rest, you feel chest pain, or you feel faint, call 911 instead and do not drive yourself. New difficulty breathing when lying flat along with worsening leg swelling can mean fluid is backing up around your heart and lungs, and that needs oxygen checks, a chest X-ray and blood tests in person. I recommend a Counsel clinician also review this thread to help with follow-up afterward.
